top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is a mature, independently confirmed chain from proglucagon processing and the active truncated peptide to human incretin physiology and durable agonists with large-trial benefit. P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) keeps the citation on discovery of a principle, which fits the Physiology or Medicine tradition; Mojsov's priority is contested but identification and synthesis of the active peptide is a distinct, testable step. P002 (Knudsen in place of Mojsov) is a defensible second that I would accept, and any GLP-1 award is better than no award.
